description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ADS SERVING
X Ads is one of the highest-leverage product areas at X. You'll work on the backend and infrastructure that powers advertising at massive scale, directly affects the business, and is being rebuilt with modern infrastructure and AI at the center. This is an opportunity to join a small, fast-moving team where engineers can take on real ownership, learn from strong teammates, and ship systems that matter.
We're looking for high-slope backend engineers who want to help rebuild and transform the X Ads Platform using SpaceXSI's infrastructure and AI stack. This role is a great fit for engineers who learn quickly, ship fast, and want to work on low-latency, high-QPS distributed systems that operate at massive scale. You do not need to have deep ads experience already, but you should be excited to learn how large-scale advertising systems work — from serving and auctions to event pipelines, attribution, billing, and reliability.
You'll work on the core backend services and infrastructure that directly impact the majority of X's revenue.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, build, and operate backend services and infrastructure across the X Ads Platform
Work on systems related to ad serving, real-time bidding and auctions, pacing and budgeting, and data pipelines for ads events, attribution, and billing
Build and scale low-latency, high-QPS distributed services, including storage, reliability, and observability
Use SpaceXSI's infrastructure and AI capabilities to improve the performance and reliability of advertising systems
Collaborate closely with engineers, product leads, and cross-functional partners to deliver production-ready systems
Learn quickly, take ownership, and operate in a fast-moving environment where high-quality execution matters
Debug, maintain, and improve production systems that serve real traffic and drive significant business impact
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
5+ years of experience building software through internships, projects, research, open-source work, startups, or full-time roles
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Strong software engineering fundamentals
Ability to write clean, maintainable code and learn new codebases quickly
Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working through ambiguity
Experience building backend services, distributed systems, or data pipelines
A bias toward action: you like shipping, operating systems in production, and improving quickly
Strong ownership mindset and willingness to take responsibility for meaningful parts of the stack
Interest in low-latency systems, high-throughput services, reliability, or observability
Experience with ads, real-time bidding, auctions, serving, pacing, billing, recommendations, search, or ranking systems
Experience working with large-scale backend systems or data processing pipelines
Experience with Golang, Python, Rust, C++, Java, Scala, or gRPC
Experience with storage systems, streaming/event pipelines, or production reliability and observability
Prior startup, research, internship, or high-impact project experience
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
$180,000 - $330,000 USD
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.
